Title: Circulation API 2: built for kiosks and reading apps - Bindlewick blog

# Circulation API 2 is here

Libraries asked for an API that speaks the way circulation staff do, and for one that works
as well for a self-service kiosk as for a reading app on a patron's phone. Version 2 of the
Circulation API is our answer.

What's new: holds you can place and cancel from anywhere, multi-site libraries handled as
first-class citizens, and timestamps that know which time zone a branch is in. Under the
hood, version 2 answers 40% faster at the 99th percentile.

Version 1 keeps working until the end of October, so there is time to move. Our developer
relations team will run two open office hours in September; book a slot from your
Bindlewick console. The changelog lists everything a version 1 client has to change.
